Commentary.Commentary: The ball is turning but dew might come into play, so can Afghanistan avoid a whitewash? Join us after the break to find out.
So 250 is the target for West Indies if they are to inflict a first-ever whitewash in ODIs for Afghanistan. Can West Indies start West Indies tenure with a win?

West Indies will be disappointed with their bowling performance at the death. From overs 46 to 49, they conceded 50 runs. Keemo Paul was the pick of the bowlers picking up 3 wickets. He was brilliant throughout the day apart from his final over where he conceded 16 off his overall tally of 44 runs. Chase was good once again. Being economical and picking up a wicket. Alzarri Joseph got two scalps to his name but was expensive. Shepherd was the other bowler to get into the wickets column. It was a miserable day for Hayden Walsh as he went for more than 7 rpo in his 7 overs, giving away 51 runs.

After being put into bat, Afghanistan once again got off to a bad start losing debutant Ibrahim Zadran early. Rahmat Shah too struggled but a fifty from Hazratullah Zazai made the total a bit more respectable. Apart from that, the hosts were struggling before Asghar Afghan and Mohammad Nabi showed their maturity. The duo took their time, churned out singles and doubles, got their eyes in and then went berserk in the final overs. The duo added 127 runs with both the batters getting to their fifties. Afghan was the star and was unlucky to miss out on a well-deserved 100.

Excellent last over from Romario Shepherd. His brilliant work in the final over has stopped Afghanistan from reaching 260 but the final fury belonged to the hosts. It looked like Afghanistan would struggle to get to even 230 but the experienced duo of Nabi and Afghan ensured West Indies would need to chase their highest total against Afghanistan if they are to win here.

EDGY FOUR! A welcome one for Afghanistan. Good length ball outside off, Hazratullah looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge of the bat towards third man and into the fence.
On a length on middle, Zazai flicks it to mid-wicket for nothing.
Full delivery on off, Zazai gets his bat down and defends it to cover.
Short ball outside off, Hazratullah cuts it towards the backward point region and takes a single.
Flighted ball on middle and leg, Hazratullah flicks it towards mid-wicket where the fielder dives to stop the ball.
Fullish delivery on off, Ikram pushes it towards long off and gets off the mark with a single.
Floated ball on off, Ali Khil blocks it out.
Flighted ball on middle, Ikram defends it of the front foot towards the bowler.
Fullish delivery around off, Hazratullah pushes it towards long off and crosses over for a single.
Full delivery on off, Zazai defends it off the front foot towards cover.
Powerplay 2 is signalled. Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Ikram looks to cut but misses it. End of Powerplay 1 and what a way to end it. Wicket maiden for Keemo Paul. Afghanistan are 45/2.
On a good length on off, Ali Khil defends it out.
Outside off, Ali Khil leaves it alone.
Ikram Ali Khil is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afghanistan lose their second wicket. Short of a length delivery, Shah looks to pull it behind square on the leg side but the ball comes earlier than he anticipated. Rahmat manages to lob it towards deep mid-wicket. Nicholas Pooran at deep square leg runs to his left and takes a comfortable catch. Crucial wicket for West Indies at this stage as Rahmat Shah has been one of the best Afghanistan batters in this side.
Full delivery on off, Shah drives it to covers.
On a good length and outside off, Rahmat shoulders arms to this one.
Keemo Paul is into the attack.
Flatter delivery on off, Zazai guides it to short third man for nothing.
Short delivery outside off, Zazai cuts it off the back foot towards the point region for nothing.
Fullish delivery on middle, Rahmat drives it to mid on and takes a single.
Flighted ball on middle, Rahmat comes down the track and defends it out.
Full delivery on middle, Rahmat defends it back to the bowler.

SIX! Beautiful use of the feet from Shah! Chase bowls a flighted delivery on off, Rahmat comes down the track and lifts this over the bowler's head and into the long off fence. First six for Rahmat in this innings.
Good length ball on middle, Zazai defends it back to the bowler. What should have been a wicket has ended up being a good over for Afghanistan.
Good length ball on middle, Zazai defends it towards point.
FOUR! Brilliant batting this from Zazai! Back of a length delivery outside off, Hazratullah camps back and cuts it towards the backward point region for another boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Hazratullah flicks it towards the leg side for nothing.
SIX! Bang! Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Zazai flicks this beautifully over the deep mid-wicket region for the first maximum of the game. He is looking in good touch here.

DROPPED! Evin Lewis is the culprit! Good length ball outside off, Rahmat looks to play it towards the off side but it hits the upper half of the bat and it goes towards Evin Lewis at point. He jumps up and tries to catch it with his one hand but fails to hold onto it. Rahmat gets a let off.
Alzarri Joseph has a change of ends.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Zazai looks to flick it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. No run.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Zazai looks to flick it but gets a leading edge on that. The ball was uppish for a while but it bounces in front of the cover fielder.
Floated ball on middle, Hazratullah defends it out.
Flighted ball on middle, Zazai defends it off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
Tosses this ball on off, Rahmat pushes this to long on and crosses over for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Shah pushes it back to the bowler.
Roston Chase is into the attack.
Good length ball on off, Zazai defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Dismissed! Short ball on the leg stump line, Hazratullah stands tall and pulls it with disdain towards the backward square leg region for a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side.

Good length ball outside off, Hazratullah drives this towards covers and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses and the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket allowing the batsman to take an extra run.
Short ball on middle, Zazai pulls it nicely but finds the fielder at short fine leg. No run.
On a length on off, Zazai defends it to point.

Good length ball on the leg stump line, Rahmat looks to flick it but gets hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire. It looked as if the ball was drifting down the leg side.
Good length ball outside off, Rahmat drives this towards the point region for nothing.
Back of a length delivery on the pads, Zazai works it to short fine leg and takes a single.
Good length ball on off, Rahmat looks to defend it but it goes off the inside half of the bat which rolls just past the stumps. The ball goes towards square leg and the batters take a single.
Good length ball on off, Shah looks to defend but it goes off the inside edge and onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side.
On a length outside off, Rahmat cuts it off the back foot towards point but the fielder makes a good diving stop. No run.
Short ball outside off, Zazai cuts it off the back foot towards the deep point region for two. The fielder from cover runs after it and makes the stop before the ball can reach the fence.
WIDE! Shepherd drifts this full delivery down the leg side, Hazratullah looks to flick it but misses it. It is wided.
Short ball outside off, Zazai looks to play the upper cut but fails to put any bat on it.
Full delivery on off, Zazai pushes it towards mid off.
On a length on middle, Hazratullah flicks it off the back foot to square leg for nothing.
Full delivery on middle, Zazai flicks it towards square leg for nothing.
Good length ball on the pads, Zazai looks to pull it awkwardly but is late. He gets hit on the thigh pad and the ball lobs towards the leg side.
Full delivery on middle, Shah drives it straight back to the bowler. A WICKET MAIDEN FOR ALZARRI!
Good length ball on middle, Rahmat defends it back to the bowler.
Rahmat Shah is the next batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Beautiful piece of bowling from Alzarri Joseph! The debutant does not make much of an impact here! After constantly bowling in the channel outside off, Alzarri changes his line and goes fuller on middle and off. Ibrahim looks to flick but is late in getting his bat down. He misses and the ball hits him flush on the pads. The West Indies players put in an appeal and the umpire raises  his finger immediately. Once again a poor start for Afghanistan.
BEATEN! Poor shot from the debutant! Alzarri bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, Zadran comes forward and looks to heave it towards the leg side but fails to make any connection to it.
Good length delivery outside off, Zadran pushes it to covers.
Good length ball outside off, Ibrahim shoulders arms to this one.
Good length ball on off, Zazai defends it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Zazai is looking good here! Good length ball outside off, Zazai pushes this nicely through covers and picks another boundary. The fielder hares after it from cover and tries to make a diving stop but fails to do so.
Good length ball around off, Ibrahim guides this to third man and crosses over for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Zadran defends it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on off, Zadran defends it off the back foot towards cover. Ibrahim looks to take the single but is sent back.
Full delivery on off, Ibrahim pushes it towards the mid off region.
Romario Shepherd to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Fullish delivery outside off, Hazratullah lifts this one over the cover fielder and the ball rolls into the fence. Good start for Afghanistan as 10 runs have come off the over.
On a length on middle, Hazratullah defends this off the back foot towards the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely played! Joseph bowls this short outside off, Zazai stands tall and cuts it towards the backward point region for the first boundary of the game.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Zadran flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets off the mark in his ODI career with a single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Zazai gets off the mark by flicking this ball towards mid-wicket.
Starts with a good length ball outside off, Hazratullah Zazai drives this but straight to the fielder at cover.

We are all set to begin! Ibrahim Zadran, the debutant and Hazratullah Zazai make their way out to the middle. The West Indies players also make their way to the middle. Alzarri Joseph to start with the first new ball for West Indies.

Rashid Khan, the Afghanistan skipper says that the track looks good to bat on and they will look to put runs on the board. Further says that they are ready to go. Adds that they have a young side and they are raring to go. States that they are struggling a bit in the top order. Adds that Ibrahim Zadran is making his debut

West Indies skipper, Kieron Pollard says they came with a plan and credits his boys for stepping up. Adds giving the talent chance they deserved has helped them. Pollard tells they need to be disciplined and respond and that is what they did in the last game. Says if they keep their head level they will always be in the game. On the team changes, Pollard says they have a series coming up quickly after this and they want to give others chance as well, hence Cottrell and Holder make way for Keemo Paul and debutant Brandon King.

Pitch Report - Alistair Campbell is down with the pitch report. Campbell tells this is the brightest day they have seen in this series. On the pitch, Campbell says that it is the same pitch used for the last game. Tells there are some tacky patches in the good length area and there will be more spin than the last game as this is a used pitch. Adds that there will be bounce and carry as well as. Campbell feels dew will once again play a big role.

Roston Chase is caught down for a quick interview with Alistair Campbell. On being asked what this series win means for West Indies, Chase tells winning it means a lot especially coming to India and winning against Afghanistan. On being asked whether he has enjoyed bowling here, Roston says the pitch has been offering him a lot and he is just looking to bowl in the right areas. On his batting, he says the management thought it would be better if he bats up and they are just backing him to play his natural game.

West Indies (PLAYING XI) - Brandon King ( In place of SHELDON COTTRELL)(DEBUT), Evin Lewis, Shai Hope (WK), Shimron Hetmyer, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard (C), Roston Chase, Keemo Paul (In place of JASON HOLDER), Alzarri Joseph, Romario Shepherd, Hayden Walsh.

Afghanistan (PLAYING XI) - Hazratullah Zazai, Ibrahim Zadran (In place of JAVED AHMADI), Rahmat Shah, Ikram Ali Khil (WK), Asghar Afghan, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Sharafuddin Ashraf, Rashid Khan (C), Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Yamin Ahmadzai (In place of NAVEEN-UL-HAQ).
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of West Indies. They have chosen to bowl first.

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of the third ODI between Afghanistan and West Indies. Afghanistan are going through a rough patch having lost 11 matches in a row starting from the World Cup. They have never been whitewashed in ODIs but the way they are playing right now, it seems highly likely that a whitewash is on the cards. West Indies, on the other hand, have been prolific in all the departments of the game. Their batting has clicked while the bowling department has done wonderfully well. This is their chance to whitewash a team after 5 years. Can they do it? Join us in a while to find out.
